خَوْرَمَةٌ The end, or tip, of the nose (JK, S) of a man: (S:) or the fore part of the nose: or the part between the nostrils. (K.) ―
-b2- Also, (JK, K,) as being likened thereto, (TA,) (assumed tropical:) A rock in which are holes; (JK, K;) n. un. of ↓ خَوْرَمٌ : (K:) [or] the latter has this signification. (S. [But this seems to be a mistake.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
